text:
Anya: quick sync — draft cutover plan for management-plane handoff (central gateway -> per-tenant controller). Goal: dry-run in staging next week.
Dinesh: high level ok. need to confirm object set we sync: tenants, routing, certs, quota, billing tags.
Rosa: observability ask: tag at ingress with tenant_id and handoff_phase so we can filter errors during overlap.
Will: network concern: when we flip, some customers depend on static egress IPs. For those we must pre-provision NAT and advertise stable IPs from tenant plane or use SNAT preserve technique.
Anya: security: cert overlap strategy — propose cross-signed intermediate for 48h overlap, then revoke central certs. Thoughts?
Dinesh: cross-sign makes sense but ops must have automated revocation timeline to avoid stale trust. Add safety check to rotation script.
Rosa: metrics: add per-tenant p50/p95 latency and reconciliation-error rate. We'll add a dashboard and alert on >0.5% reconciliation errors for 15m.
Will: cutover steps (short): 1) enable shadow-sync, 2) validate config parity, 3) enable read-only on central controller, 4) switch DNS/route to tenant controller, 5) monitor, 6) revoke overlap certs.
Anya: rollback plan: if errors > threshold, flip DNS back, lock tenant controller to read-only, and run diff tooling to reconcile.
Dinesh: provisioning API spike — I'll open infra ticket and mock terraform module for tenant mgmt plane.
sre-bot: notice: gateway-staging-0 p95 spike at 10:12 UTC, looks like load test. Will correlate with dry-run schedule.
Rosa: schedule dry-run Tue 09:00 PT, I'll prepare dashboards and runbook.
Anya: thanks — I'll write RFC follow-up and link runbook. Keep notes here: https://go/notes/mgmt-cutover-dryrun (WIP)
